name: GloVe
statusSub: Tier 1 passed — independent Tier-2 certification pending
summary: Upstream GloVe trained from scratch on the complete text8 demo recipe: vocabulary construction, co-occurrence generation, shuffle, 15 training iterations and the supplied word-analogy evaluation. The recorded run completed all eleven workflow tasks in 3h07m53s and reported 22.99% total analogy accuracy. The model bundle and evaluation are public. Strict Clean-DAG verification passes 14/14, AI-BOM is 100/100, public URL checks pass, and the dependency freeze is portable. Independent Tier-2 certification remains pending.
difficulty: 7/10 — the published demo runs without source changes, but its three C compute stages take about three hours and the resulting record misses one strict lineage edge
experimentUrlNote: The upstream demo has no experiment-logging integration; there is no logging flag to enable.

issues.title: The demo does not set the random seeds exposed by the training binaries
issues.detail: Repeated complete runs produce different analogy accuracy because demo.sh invokes shuffle and glove without their seed flags.
issues.fix: Set and document fixed seeds in the published demo.
